runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 23:22 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and Facebook public indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, qualification, skill, economics and trust gates. Upwork produced fresh Worldwide VA/WordPress/e-commerce candidates, but visible examples were low-value fixed-price, mass-invite, already-hired, high-competition, strong-English, or expert-development scoped. Reddit returned current supply-side FOR HIRE posts rather than hiring demand. Facebook public indexing produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Freelance mass-invite risk signal
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Track invites sent, unanswered invites, hires and proposal count on freelance listings. Penalize listings with broad mass-invite behaviour or disproportionate unanswered invites before spending application time; this catches low-intent or spam-like opportunities even when headline pay looks attractive.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Already-hired listing suppression gate
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: If a freelance listing already shows one or more hires, reduce priority sharply unless the client explicitly needs multiple freelancers and remaining demand is clear. This avoids wasting application effort on technically open listings whose practical hiring window has already closed.
